title: Moonwater Temple — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist sanctuary: a three-storey vermilion pagoda with balconied upper storeys, broad bracketed eaves and a nine-ring sorin; an irimoya-roofed worship hall with a golden altar; an irimoya bell pavilion with a hanging bronze bell and log striker; and a red moon bridge arching over a koi-and-lotus pond. Moss banks, raked gravel and stepping stones guide the evening approach.
